Grafana provides built-in support for Loki. In this milestone, you navigate to Connections, search for Loki, and give your new data source a descriptive name.

To add the Loki data source, complete the following steps:
In the navigation menu, click **Connections > Data sources**.
In the **Filter by name or type** field, enter `Loki`.

At the top of the page, next to the data source name, click the edit (pencil) icon and enter a descriptive name for your Loki data source.

For example, enter `Production Loki`.

**Did you know?** The name of the data source is displayed on dashboard panels and in the data source picker in Explore, so it's important to choose a meaningful name.
In the next milestone, you configure the connection URL for your Loki backend.
